synthesis.executive_summary: 今日清单包含六项工作，其中三项直接关系 OCR/文档解析：藏文 OCR 首次引入音节级与词级评价并关联下游 NLP 任务；PDF 转 Markdown 评测揭示数字计分被记号污染的陷阱；手写文本识别的数据集蒸馏给出否定性实证。另有一项临床表单多模态 LLM 抽取系统展示人工在环的成本-精度权衡，一项犊牛行为视频数据集报告了用 OCR 读取画面时钟做时间对齐的工程做法，一项记忆系统情感评测与 OCR 无直接关系。整体看，评价方法的粒度与协议严谨性是今日最集中的关注点，而非识别架构本身。
synthesis.trend_summary: OCR 研究正从单一字符错误率转向多粒度、任务相关的评价：藏文工作用音节错误率和分词词级错误率替代 CER，PDF 转 Markdown 工作则暴露了现有数字指标在记号污染下的失真。与此同时，序列识别任务上的数据效率方法（数据集蒸馏）遭遇负面结果，说明分类任务的合成数据思路不能直接迁移。下游任务驱动的抽取系统（临床表单）更关注人工在环的成本-精度平衡，而非纯端到端精度。
common_innovations: 将评价粒度从字符级扩展到音节级、词级或下游任务指标，并检验不同粒度下系统排序是否一致。
在评测前显式剥离转换器生成的记号（链接路径、HTML 属性），避免评分伪影。
用双模型或双引擎分歧触发选择性人工复核，以较低成本检测错误。
将分类任务的数据集蒸馏方法适配到 CTC 序列识别，并用真实初始化行作为受控基线。
利用 OCR 读取画面烧录时钟实现视频帧与标注时间的自动对齐。
future_directions: 为藏文等无空格文字建立不依赖分词器的词级代理指标，并在多书写风格与退化图像上验证其与分词词级错误率排序的一致性。
制定 PDF 转 Markdown 的数字与单位评测协议，规定记号剥离、漏检与错检分开统计，并引入第三引擎或专用数字检测器以提升分歧检查对共享漏检的召回。
将音节错误率或词级错误率作为训练辅助损失微调 OCR 模型，并在下游词性、实体与翻译任务上验证增益。
探索面向 CTC 对齐层面的序列识别蒸馏目标，替代基于字符 n-gram 伪类聚类的分类式蒸馏，并在 Transformer 识别器上复验。
针对手绘与钟表绘制等歧义图形，引入专用视觉推理或不确定性校准模块，减少临床表单抽取中的定性错误。
在更多牧场与季节跨度上检验 OCR 时钟对齐误差对行为时序建模的影响，并将该对齐做法推广到其他视频标注流水线。
engineering_takeaways: 藏文 OCR 部署前可用音节错误率做低成本快速评估，无需依赖分词器；但词级指标仍需报告分词器版本。
PDF 转 Markdown 流水线在计算数字或单位 F1 前必须先剥离图片链接路径与 HTML 属性中的数字，否则会误判基线优劣。
双引擎分歧检查对数字错误的召回有限（本研究中约 13%），不能单独作为数字正确性的验收手段，需补充抽样人工核查。
在手写文本识别中不要直接套用分类任务的数据集蒸馏方法，受控实验显示其蒸馏集不如随机选取的真实起始行。
临床表单抽取采用表单分类器加评分类抽取器的模块化架构，并用双模型分歧触发人工复核，可在准确率与人工量之间取得可量化的平衡。
视频标注流水线可用 OCR 读取画面烧录时钟来自动对齐帧与标注时间，但需评估时间戳误差对时序建模的影响。

papers.title: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
papers.summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
papers.zh_summary: 该研究针对藏文OCR长期仅以字符错误率(CER)评价的问题，在排版、木刻和两种手写体及组合条件下评估了九种识别器配置（CTC模型、带/不带训练后量化的TrOCR编解码器、一个视觉语言模型），首次系统报告藏文OCR的音节级和词级错误率，并分析下游词性标注、命名实体和机器翻译质量与错误率的关系。
papers.novelty: 首次为藏文OCR建立音节级(SER)与分词词级(SWER)评价体系，并系统关联下游NLP任务表现。
innovation_points: 提出无需分词器的音节错误率(SER)作为藏文OCR的替代评价指标，并验证其与三种分词器下SWER的排序一致性
构建跨排版、木刻、手写多字体的九配置评测矩阵，涵盖CTC、TrOCR和VLM三类范式
将OCR错误率与词性保持、命名实体保持、翻译chrF等下游任务指标建立定量阈值关系
papers.limitations: 样本仅涉及九种配置和特定数据来源，SWER依赖分词器且三种分词器间存在差异；下游阈值仅为粗略指导，实体保持率与错误率之间未找到可分离系统的阈值。
improvement_directions: 扩展至更多藏文书写风格与真实场景退化图像，验证SER与SWER排序一致性的稳健性
研究藏文专用分词器对SWER评价稳定性的影响，或设计不依赖分词器的词级代理指标
探索以SER为训练目标或辅助损失的识别模型微调，检验下游任务增益
papers.engineering_value: 为藏文OCR系统选型提供多粒度评价依据，尤其SER可在无分词器条件下低成本反映系统质量，适合作为藏文OCR部署前的快速评估指标。
papers.why_relevant: 直接涉及OCR评价指标设计（CER/SER/SWER）及OCR输出对下游NLP任务的影响，是OCR文档解析评价方法学的重要参考。

papers.title: Digits in Notation Are Not Numbers: A Scoring Pitfall in PDF-to-Markdown Conversion of Japanese Technical Documents (Preliminary Evaluation)
papers.summary: Converting PDFs to Markdown is now routine preprocessing for search and language models, yet scoring the numbers in the output is easy to get wrong. We evaluate MinerU, a plain-text OCR baseline (NDLOCR-Lite), and a deterministic post-processing pipeline (anchor insertion, footnote reordering, fixes of look-alike characters in fixed contexts, gated formula repair using two independent OCR partners, and heading reconstruction) on 48 public Japanese pages (three documents), text-layer and rasterized. Our pre-specified number-and-unit F1 favored the OCR baseline (0.575 vs 0.397), and a disagreement check between the two engines seemed to flag about half of the converter's number errors (54.6%). Both were artifacts. The scorer counted digits in the converter's notation (image-link paths, HTML attributes), which plain text lacks. With the notation removed (a post-hoc check), the F1 scores tie (0.575 vs 0.594), and the check flags only 13% of number errors, because most errors are misses that both engines share. What remains: the OCR baseline has a lower body character error rate (0.012 vs 0.053 rasterized). The pipeline raises extra-number recall at page level (+0.145; the document-level interval touches 0), mostly by restoring page numbers, but lowers heading-level agreement (0.133 to 0.061) and leaves spurious formulas unchanged; its formula repair never fires. A pre-specified precision gate for its flags (0.80, human-judged) is met at 0.929, yet the post-processing hypothesis fails on its improvement items. We recommend scoring numbers after removing notation and checking critical figures against the source. By the pre-specified criteria, the study stays a technical report.
papers.zh_summary: 论文评估MinerU、纯文本OCR基线(NDLOCR-Lite)及确定性后处理流水线在48页日文技术文档PDF转Markdown任务上的表现，发现预先设定的数字与单位F1评分因把转换器记号（图片链接路径、HTML属性）中的数字计入而失真；去除记号后F1基本持平，双引擎分歧检查仅能标记13%的数字错误，因为多数错误是两引擎共同的漏检。
papers.novelty: 揭示PDF转Markdown评测中数字计分受记号污染的陷阱，并通过消融证明多数数字错误为共享漏检。
innovation_points: 指出并量化了数字评分中记号（链接路径、HTML属性）导致的评分伪影，提出评分前去除记号的修正流程
设计双引擎分歧检查用于数字错误检测，并分析其低召回原因（共享漏检）
构建包含锚点插入、脚注重排、形近字修复、门控公式修复与标题重建的确定性后处理流水线并进行预注册假设检验
papers.limitations: 仅48页、三份文档，样本量小；后处理假设在改进项上未成立，公式修复从未触发，标题级一致性反而下降；文档级区间触及零。
improvement_directions: 建立更规范的PDF转Markdown数字与单位评测协议，明确记号剥离、漏检与错检的分离统计
针对两引擎共享漏检问题，引入第三引擎或针对性数字检测模块以提升分歧检查召回
改进公式修复的门控触发条件与标题重建策略，避免标题一致性下降
papers.engineering_value: 为PDF转Markdown流水线的评测设计提供可直接采纳的评分修正建议，避免因记号污染误判基线优劣，对文档解析系统质量评估有直接工程指导意义。
papers.why_relevant: 聚焦OCR/文档转换输出（数字、公式、标题）的评测方法学，与OCR文档解析评价直接相关。

papers.title: Dataset Distillation for Handwritten Text Recognition: An Empirical Study
papers.summary: Dataset distillation (DD) replaces large training datasets with smaller synthetic ones to reduce computational costs. While traditionally used for classification, we present, to our knowledge, the first DD study for line-level handwritten text recognition (HTR). Unlike classification tasks, which use discrete labels, HTR employs unaligned sequences from a virtually infinite output space as labels. To adapt classification-based DD methods to this scenario, we define text pseudo-classes by clustering transcriptions based on character n-grams. We adapt gradient matching (GM), distribution matching (DM) and trajectory matching (MTT) to a Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) trained with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC). In this process, synthetic line images are generated by optimising only the pixels of real starting lines (either randomly chosen or selected as text medoids), while keeping their original transcriptions fixed. Across four datasets (IAM, George Washington, READ\,2016, LAM) and three budgets (1--10\,\% of the training lines), no distilled set outperforms its real initialisation lines. Random lines prove better than medoids, and further optimisation only degrades recognition. Methodologically, DM lowers its objective without benefit, while GM and MTT barely move theirs. We turn these findings into guidelines for evaluating data compression in HTR.
papers.zh_summary: 论文首次将数据集蒸馏(DD)引入行级手写文本识别(HTR)，通过字符n-gram聚类转录文本构造伪类，将梯度匹配、分布匹配和轨迹匹配适配到CTC训练的CRNN上，在四个数据集和1%–10%预算下实验发现蒸馏集均不如其真实初始化行，随机行优于文本中位样本，进一步优化只会降低识别性能。
papers.novelty: 首次系统研究行级HTR的数据集蒸馏，并给出否定性实证结论与评估指南。
innovation_points: 利用转录文本的字符n-gram聚类定义伪类，将面向分类的DD方法迁移到无限输出空间的序列识别任务
将GM、DM、MTT三种蒸馏方法适配到CTC+CRNN框架，并仅在真实起始行像素上优化而固定转录标签
在四个HTR数据集与三档压缩预算下建立受控对比，揭示随机初始化行优于中位样本的现象
papers.limitations: 未能在任何设置下超越真实起始行，方法适配后目标函数下降但不带来识别收益；仅覆盖CRNN+CTC架构，未验证其他序列识别模型。
improvement_directions: 探索面向序列标签的蒸馏目标（如CTC对齐层面的匹配）而非依赖伪类聚类
在Transformer/TrOCR等非CTC架构上验证蒸馏可行性
研究蒸馏集与真实数据混合训练或课程式采样以发挥合成数据价值
papers.engineering_value: 为HTR数据压缩与合成数据使用提供负面证据与评估规范，避免工程上盲目采用分类式蒸馏方法造成算力浪费。
papers.why_relevant: 涉及手写文本识别（OCR核心任务）的训练数据范式与CTC框架，对OCR模型训练方法研究有参考价值。

papers.title: A Visual Information Extraction System Using Multimodal Large Language Models for Scanned Cognitive and Behavioral Assessments
papers.summary: Objective. Paper-based assessments are common in patient care, but handwriting and scanning artifacts make these forms difficult to process at scale. This study proposes a modular, multimodal LLM-based system with human oversight for extracting fields and scores. We conducted a qualitative analysis of the use of LLMs for hand-drawing analysis. Materials and Methods. The system processes cognitive assessments (i.e., MMSE, MoCA, Mini-Cog) and the NICHQ Vanderbilt Assessment using two modules: 1) a form classifier that assigns a scanned page to a form type, followed by a corresponding 2) score extractor that extracts fields and scores into a schema. A human-in-the-loop design utilizing dual-model validation engages human annotators when two LLMs disagree, limiting manual review to challenging pages only. Results. End-to-end accuracy for cognitive assessments was 88%, with most form types exceeding 90%. For the NICHQ Vanderbilt, overall accuracy reached 97.5%, with all form types above 96%. The human-in-the-loop design further improved cognitive assessment accuracy to 97.5% while reducing manual work by 63.8%. In the Mini-Cog Clock Drawing task, qualitative analysis showed that 62.3% of all extraction errors stemmed from ambiguous drawing, in which cases the LLM provided reasonable readings. Discussion. Compared to current manual data extraction, our LLM-based system reduces processing time by 10 to 20 times and costs by over 12 times. The modular design allows seamless expansion to additional form types. Conclusion. Our system provides an accurate, scalable, and cost-efficient solution for structuring data trapped in handwritten paper forms for clinical decision support.
papers.zh_summary: 研究提出模块化多模态LLM系统，用于扫描的纸质认知评估(MMSE、MoCA、Mini-Cog)和NICHQ Vanderbilt量表的信息抽取：先由表单分类器识别页面类型，再由对应评分抽取器将字段与分数写入schema，并采用双模型验证的人工在环机制。认知评估端到端准确率88%，Vanderbilt达97.5%，人工在环将认知评估提升至97.5%并减少63.8%人工量。
papers.novelty: 将多模态LLM与双模型分歧触发的人工在环机制结合，用于临床认知与行为评估扫描表单的结构化抽取。
innovation_points: 模块化表单分类器+评分类抽取器的两阶段架构，便于扩展到新表单类型
双LLM验证驱动的选择性人工复核机制，仅在模型分歧时引入标注员，兼顾准确率与人工成本
对Mini-Cog钟表绘制等手绘任务进行定性错误分析，识别歧义绘图为主要错误来源
papers.limitations: 认知评估端到端准确率未达100%，抽取错误中62.3%源于绘图歧义；样本与表单类型有限，仅在特定量表上验证。
improvement_directions: 针对手绘/钟表绘制的歧义问题引入专用视觉推理或不确定性校准模块
扩展至更多临床表单与跨机构扫描条件，检验模块化架构的泛化性
探索无需双模型全量推理的高效分歧检测以进一步降低计算成本
papers.engineering_value: 提供可复用的临床表单OCR+LLM抽取系统范式与人工在环成本-精度权衡数据，处理时间缩短10–20倍、成本降低12倍以上，具备落地价值。
papers.why_relevant: 涉及扫描文档的字段级信息抽取与多模态LLM应用，属于OCR向文档理解延伸的工程实践。

papers.title: Video recordings and play behaviour annotations of group-housed dairy calves on two Dutch farms
papers.summary: Play is used as an indicator of positive welfare in dairy calves, but openly available video of group-housed calves with individual behaviour annotations is scarce. We describe video from four camera deployments of about one week each in group pens of dairy calves on two farms in the Netherlands: a research and teaching dairy farm (2024 and 2025) and a commercial dairy farm (2024). The recordings comprise 1,173 video files spanning 651 h. For eight observation days, trained observers coded calf behaviour continuously in Noldus The Observer XT with an 18-item ethogram of play and other behaviours, covering 104 h of video, 90 h of which have every calf in the pen coded. The release also contains 1.1 million decoded frames from seven annotated sessions, a per-frame timestamp read by optical character recognition from the camera clock burned into each frame, per-calf segmentation tracks and per-calf frame-level play labels. The data support studies of calf behaviour and welfare and the development and evaluation of automated behaviour recognition.
papers.zh_summary: 该数据集论文公开了荷兰两个牧场群养奶犊牛的四组摄像头视频，共1,173个文件、651小时，其中8个观察日由训练观察员以18项行为谱连续编码104小时（90小时覆盖栏内全部犊牛），并发布110万解码帧、逐帧OCR读取的摄像头时钟时间戳、逐犊牛分割轨迹及帧级玩耍标签。
papers.novelty: 提供带个体级行为标注与OCR时间戳的群养犊牛视频公开数据集，填补此类资源稀缺。
innovation_points: 以OCR从画面上烧录的摄像头时钟读取逐帧时间戳，实现视频帧与标注时间的对齐
提供逐犊牛分割轨迹与帧级玩耍行为标签，支持自动化行为识别训练与评测
跨研究牧场与商业牧场多摄像头部署，覆盖不同养殖环境
papers.limitations: 仅两个牧场、四组部署，观察日仅8天；部分视频（14小时）未对全部犊牛编码；商业牧场数据仅2024年一组。
improvement_directions: 扩展牧场数量与季节跨度以提升行为识别模型的域泛化评估
利用OCR时钟对齐质量分析时间戳误差对行为时序建模的影响
将逐犊牛轨迹与玩耍标签用于弱监督或多目标跟踪联合识别研究
papers.engineering_value: 为动物行为自动识别提供带时间戳与个体轨迹的基准数据，OCR读取画面时钟的做法可推广到其他视频标注流水线的时间对齐环节。
papers.why_relevant: OCR被用作视频帧时间戳提取的关键组件，体现OCR在非传统文档场景中的工程应用。

papers.title: MemEmo: Evaluating Emotion in Memory Systems
papers.summary: Memory systems address the challenge of context loss in Large Language Models during prolonged interactions. However, as an essential tool for warm companionship and personalized services, the effectiveness of memory systems in processing affective information remains underexamined. To bridge this gap, we propose an emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark to assess the performance of mainstream and state-of-the-art memory systems in integrating and harnessing emotional information. First, we design a benchmark called \textbf{MemEmo} to assess the affective reasoning and tracking capabilities of memory systems across four dimensions: emotional information extraction, emotional memory updating, emotional memory question-answering, and emotional conflict detection. Second, we construct the \textbf{H}uman-\textbf{L}ike \textbf{M}emory \textbf{E}motion (\textbf{HLME}) dataset to provide an empirical foundation for scrutinizing memory systems. Finally, We evaluate five representative memory systems on the HLME dataset, reporting 11 performance metrics across four dimensions. Experimental results reveal that aggregating scores for all tested memory systems is up to 45\%, far below 100\% scale, exposing a profound disparity between memory system and affective intelligence.
papers.zh_summary: 论文提出MemEmo情感增强记忆评测基准与HLME数据集，从情感信息抽取、情感记忆更新、情感记忆问答和情感冲突检测四个维度评估五种主流记忆系统，报告11项指标，结果显示各系统综合得分最高仅约45%，暴露记忆系统与情感智能之间的显著差距。
papers.novelty: 首次系统评测记忆系统处理情感信息的能力，并构建对应基准与人类式记忆情感数据集。
innovation_points: 定义情感记忆评测的四维框架：抽取、更新、问答与冲突检测
构建HLME数据集为记忆系统情感能力提供实证基础
在五种代表性记忆系统上以11项指标开展多维评测并给出聚合得分
papers.limitations: 评测系统数量有限（五种），数据集规模与情感场景覆盖可能受限；未针对情感记忆缺陷提出具体改进方法。
improvement_directions: 设计针对情感信息抽取与冲突检测的专门记忆架构或检索策略
扩展数据集至多轮长程对话与跨语言情感场景，提升评测覆盖
将情感记忆指标与下游个性化服务效果关联验证其预测效度
papers.engineering_value: 为对话记忆系统的情感能力提供可量化评测工具，指导个性化服务中记忆模块的设计取舍。
papers.why_relevant: 虽不直接涉及OCR，但涉及文档/对话信息抽取与记忆系统的评测方法，属广义信息处理评测参考。
